snapshot_semantics.rule: Fetch current live refs before local work. Never overwrite a moved branch; work in an isolated child branch.

objective: Implement and validate an independent two-sided matching cross-check for the existing analytic two-phase sharp-Maxwell relativistic Cowling fixture using the weighted Abel-Liouville determinant invariant.

hypotheses: same background, omega, ell and sound-speed closure for both columns
caveats: not a canonical covariant symplectic current
normalised angle is not a holomorphic Evans function
nonbarotropic chi_ad != chi_eq requires a new weight/system derivation
raw determinant is the exact analytic matching scalar only when coefficient and endpoint basis dependence is analytic; scale factors must be retained
normalized determinant angle is real-frequency diagnostic only and is generally non-holomorphic for complex omega
at Omega_inner=0 the observed interface ratio is undefined and must serialize as null plus status

root_function_policy.raw_weighted_determinant: exact_zero_set; preferred analytic scalar only with holomorphic ODE and endpoint bases
root_function_policy.complex_frequency: use holomorphic scaled/exterior or multiple_shooting determinant; retain all scale phases
root_function_policy.qr_rule: Y=Q*R; retain det(Q)*det(R), not Q alone
root_function_policy.zero_denominator_ratio: null plus UNDEFINED_ZERO_DENOMINATOR; no NaN or infinity
root_function_policy.surface: same finite-pressure cutoff in both directions; not assumed P=0

limitations: A generic nonbarotropic system may contain composition-gradient terms or additional variables; recompute the complete trace before using this formula.
The finite-rate reactive interface condition from radial literature is not automatically a transfer map for this nonradial 2x2 system.
A singular transfer matrix makes the inverse jump factor undefined.
This is an algebraic determinant concomitant, not a canonical covariant symplectic current.

trace_first_general.identity: For Y'=M(r)Y and Omega=w(r)*det(Y), Gamma=tr(M)+d(log w)/dr; for w=h*exp(-nu), Gamma=tr(M)+h_prime/h-nu_prime.
required_order: derive and verify the complete implemented matrix M or square system Jacobian
calculate its full trace directly from the source equations
derive d(log h)/dr and nu_prime from the equilibrium background
only then simplify to the chi_ad/chi_eq shortcut if the exact 2x2 Cowling trace and cold first law are verified
limitations: determinant identity is algebraic and basis-dependent, not a canonical symplectic current
for an n-by-n system use the complete square fundamental matrix and the determinant of the actual n-by-n interface map
if the perturbation system is not square or the map loses rank, stop and reformulate instead of forcing the 2x2 formula
do not infer a physical conservation law from the compensated determinant

analytic_finite_interval_matching.parameter: zeta in a declared complex domain Omega; do not conflate the spectral parameter with the metric potential lambda
analytic_finite_interval_matching.interface: y_o=T_k(zeta)y_i, with every T_k holomorphic and invertible on the claimed domain, or use a full-rank implicit interface constraint
analytic_finite_interval_matching.endpoint_frames: Phi_c and Phi_s must be holomorphic, full column rank, with fixed complementary dimensions p and n-p
analytic_finite_interval_matching.determinant: D(zeta;rm)=det[Phi_c(rm,zeta),Phi_s(rm,zeta)] using a bilinear determinant without conjugation
sufficient_hypotheses: M_j(r,zeta) is holomorphic in zeta and locally uniformly L1 in r on each layer
the endpoint admissible subspaces have constant dimension and full-rank holomorphic frames
all interface maps or implicit constraint matrices are holomorphic on the domain and have the required rank
the parameter domain excludes unresolved coefficient, endpoint and interface singularities
analytic_finite_interval_matching.zero_set: D=0 iff the propagated center and surface admissible subspaces intersect nontrivially
analytic_finite_interval_matching.multiplicity: zero order equals BVP algebraic multiplicity only after the actual BVP is shown to be a regular holomorphic Fredholm pencil and the matching matrix an analytic invertible reduction
analytic_finite_interval_matching.basis_cocycle: D_tilde=D*det(A_c)*det(A_s); A_c,A_s must be holomorphic units on the whole contour interior
analytic_finite_interval_matching.normalization: Hermitian norms, Gram-Schmidt, unitary QR/SVD and polar decompositions are not holomorphic in complex zeta. They may be conditioning diagnostics only; any numerical frame factor used in D must be restored in full including volume and phase.
analytic_finite_interval_matching.scope: finite-interval characteristic determinant; do not import whole-line stable/unstable, essential-spectrum or exponential-dichotomy hypotheses unless the actual problem is whole-line

zero_A.theta_lt_1_kappa_ne_1: C_outer loses rank and no graph transfer exists; keep C_inner/C_outer implicit and use multi-domain matching
zero_A.theta_eq_1: use explicit analytic rapid endpoint extension [V]=0; this agrees with original rapid relation for A!=0, but is a selected extension at A=0
zero_A.kappa_eq_1: no enthalpy jump; use exact identity map

la10_implicit_interface_regularization.conditioning: with x=A/(nu_prime*L), dimensionless state (W/L^3,V/L^2), cond2(T_hat)=O(|x|^-2)=O(|omega|^-4); condition number is real-frequency diagnostic only
la10_implicit_interface_regularization.epistemic_scope: algebraic family only; theta is not a physical conversion rate or finite-rate kinetic law

non_goals: raw EOS or canonical manifest mutation
physical finite-rate interface kinetics absent a sourced constitutive law
